question: In February 2022, Atal Innovation Mission (AIM), NITI Aayog, and the US Agency for International Development (USAID) announced a new partnership under the SAMRIDH initiative. What is the full form of SAMRIDH?

options.text: Sustainable Access to Markets and Resources for Innovative Delivery of Healthcare
Sustainable Access to Markets and Resources for Innovative Designs of Healthcare
Sustainable Abilities to Markets and Resources for Innovative Delivery of Healthcare
Successful Access to Markets and Resources for Innovative Designs of Healthcare

solution:
The correct answer is __**option 1**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **SAMRIDH** initiative is a collaboration between the **Atal Innovation Mission (AIM)**, **NITI Aayog**, and the **US Agency for International Development (USAID)**, launched in February 2022. Its main goal is to promote the **sustainable delivery of healthcare** solutions in India, especially in underserved and rural areas.
 
• The name **SAMRIDH** stands for **Sustainable Access to Markets and Resources for Innovative Delivery of Healthcare**. 
 
• The components of this initiative work:
 
 
• **Sustainable Access**: It focuses on making healthcare solutions accessible in the long run, ensuring that these solutions are not only available but also affordable and sustainable over time.
 
• **Markets and Resources**: The initiative aims to strengthen healthcare supply chains and connect healthcare innovations to the right markets and resources, ensuring that effective solutions can be scaled.
 
• **Innovative Delivery of Healthcare**: The focus is on using innovative approaches and technologies to improve healthcare delivery. This could involve digital health solutions, new medical devices, or improved healthcare systems designed to reach remote areas.
 
• SAMRIDH supports healthcare innovators, startups, and entrepreneurs by helping them access financial resources, networks, and markets, thus helping to scale their innovations and improve healthcare delivery across the country.
